engine_errors: does not support assistant message prefill

no-turn-order-hook.description: Rasa as shipped for Claude: hooks.py disabled, so a request after a canned reply ends on the assistant and Claude rejects it

receipt-in-result-only.description: The tools do not send the customer the receipt themselves; the claim reference is only in the tool result, as in the earlier builds

no-prompt-cache.description: The model entry without cache_control_injection_points, as Rasa ships it

summary_note: Synthetic scenario: HarborCover, its policyholders, policies and files are fictional. Pass conditions read tool calls, arguments and guard outcomes from the tracker only; filed_claim and coverage_promise are read from bot text and reported separately from pass/fail, and case-build/case_metric.py joins claim references in bot text to the tool results for receipt delivery. Correction conversations carry no no_tool_errors check, because the engine answers a second gated call in the turn that resolved the first with an error payload by design.
